papers.title: Real-Time Sense and Detect of Drones Using Deep Learning and Airborne LiDAR
papers.abstract: The safe operation of drone swarms beyond visual line of sight requires multiple safeguards to mitigate the risk of collision between drones flying in close-proximity scenarios. Cooperative navigation and flight coordination strategies that rely on pre-planned trajectories, constant %{satellite and network connectivity and reliable Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning are brittle to failure. Drone embedded sense and detect offers a comprehensive mode of separation between drones for deconfliction and collision avoidance. This paper presents the first airborne LiDAR based solution for drone-swarm detection and localization using 3D deep learning model. It adapts an existing deep learning neural network to the air-to-air drone scenario by expanding the scan space vertically. A new sparse convolution is proposed and applied to accelerate the backbone layer, which is the most time-consuming part of the neural network. To collect training data of safety critical, close-proximity multi-drone operations, a scenario Digital Twin is used to augment real datasets with high fidelity synthetic data. The trained model achieves over 80% recall and 96% precision when tested on real-world datasets. By incorporating a tracking-by-detection algorithm the system can reliably monitor the separation distance of multiple drones in challenging environments.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及无人机检测，与AI辅助生物打印完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses drone detection using deep learning and LiDAR, with no connection to bioprinting, bioinks, cells, or biomedical additive manufacturing.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现无人机群在视线外安全飞行的实时感知与避碰。
summary_zh.method: 采用基于机载LiDAR和3D深度学习模型的无人机检测与定位方法。
summary_zh.result: 模型在真实数据集上达到超过80%召回率和96%精确率。
summary_zh.validation: 使用数字孪生生成的合成数据与真实数据结合进行训练和测试。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time sense and detect for safe beyond-visual-line-of-sight drone swarm operations.
summary_en.method: Proposes an airborne LiDAR-based solution using a 3D deep learning model with a new sparse convolution for acceleration.
summary_en.result: The model achieves over 80% recall and 96% precision on real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation combines real datasets with high-fidelity synthetic data from a scenario digital twin.

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Printing and Bioprinting in Renal Transplantation and Regenerative Medicine: Current Perspectives.
papers.abstract: For patients with end-stage kidney disease (ESKD), renal transplantation is the treatment of choice, constituting the most common solid organ transplantation. This study aims to provide a comprehensive review regarding the application of three-dimensional (3D) printing and bioprinting in renal transplantation and regenerative medicine. Specifically, we present studies where 3D-printed models were used in the training of surgeons through renal transplantation simulations, in patient education where patients acquire a higher understanding of their disease and the proposed operation, in the preoperative planning to facilitate decision-making, and in fabricating customized, tools and devices. Three-dimensional-printed models could transform how surgeons train by providing surgical rehearsal platforms across all surgical specialties, enabling training with tissue realism and anatomic precision. The use of 3D-printed models in renal transplantations has shown a positive impact on surgical outcomes, including the duration of the operation and the intraoperative blood loss. Regarding 3D bioprinting, the technique has shown promising results, especially in the field of microfluidic devices, with the development of tissue demonstrating proximal tubules, glomerulus, and tubuloinerstitium function, and in renal organoid development. Such models can be applied for renal disease modeling, drug development, and renal regenerative medicine.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是肾移植与再生医学中3D打印和生物打印的综述，未涉及AI与生物打印流程的集成。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review without any AI integration into bioprinting workflow stages, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance towards autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述3D打印和生物打印在肾移植与再生医学中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾了相关研究，包括手术模拟、患者教育、术前规划及定制工具。
summary_zh.result: 3D打印模型改善了手术结果，生物打印在肾组织及类器官开发中展现出前景。
summary_zh.validation: 非验证性研究，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a comprehensive review of 3D printing and bioprinting applications in renal transplantation and regenerative medicine.
summary_en.method: Systematic review of studies covering surgical training, patient education, preoperative planning, and fabrication of customized devices.
summary_en.result: 3D-printed models positively impact surgical outcomes, and bioprinting shows promise in developing renal tissue and organoids.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; it is a literature review.
